#flux: -n 1
#flux: -c 4
#flux: --time-limit=4h
#flux: --output=myjob.out

# Omitted Slurm option: --gres=gpu:1
# Flux GPU requests are site/config dependent (often via custom resource types).
# Performance implication: job may start without a GPU, causing failures or severe slowdown if GPU use is expected.

module load anaconda
module load use.own

conda env remove --name d22env
conda create --name d22env python=3.11 jupyter pytorch torchvision matplotlib pandas -y
source activate d22env
conda info --envs
echo -e "module loaded"
